monthlyPlant: Monthly cooling-plant electricity includes the chiller, fans and pumps. Electric handling is counted in the annual saving above.
monthlyChiller: Monthly chiller-package electricity equals its heat removal divided by COP. The separate dry-cooler fan and circulation pumps are outside this meter.
stockChart: Usable inventory from 1 June to 31 August. {note}
invalid: Check {field} and enter a number within the allowed range.
savings: The chiller avoids {avoided} of electricity. The snow pump uses {pumping}, and collection and handling use {handling}.
remaining: A usable reserve of {energy} remains on 31 August.
depleted: Usable reserve exhausted on {date} (source {year}, EPW hour {hour}).
zero: No usable ice energy is available on 1 June.
noPump: Snow stays in reserve. The snow pump would consume at least as much electricity as the chiller would save.
targetVolume: Compacted volume, rounded up, for {target} of useful cooling. Ideal melt alone requires {tonnes} t of ice.
overLimit: This volume exceeds the calculator’s {limit} input limit.
noDensity: This fill provides zero usable energy per cubic metre.
maxDelivery: This dispatch and exchanger can deliver at most {limit} of the {target} requested.
campusValid: 1 July stock equals initial ice energy less 2,184 hours of assumed enclosure heat gain, floored at zero. The default 200 W is a comparison input for each design.
campusInvalid: Check the density and heat gains to update the holding estimates.
replayReadout: At the end of hour {hour}, {ice} of ice energy remains. During that hour snow supplies {snow} and backup supplies {backup} of the 5 kW heat load.
dutyChart: Hourly useful snow cooling. Contact condition: {condition}.
